# Tiferes Final Plan — Canonical Browser Frames to Native ffmpeg

The Awtsmoos joins browser revelation and native encoding without confusing their roles; Awtsmoos.com keeps the semantic renderer authoritative while ffmpeg becomes only the final media vessel.

## Python source modules
- `apps/animator/tools/browser-export/ffmpeg/CanonicalFfmpegSession.py` — safe session paths, metadata, frame/audio accounting.
- `.../CanonicalFfmpegRunner.py` — ffmpeg + ffprobe argv execution and JSON result.
- `.../CanonicalFfmpegHandler.py` — localhost HTTP POST/GET routing, CORS, bounded bodies.
- `apps/animator/tools/browser-export/CanonicalFfmpegServer.py` — tiny server bootstrap.

## Browser source modules
- `apps/animator/src/studio/export/browser/CanonicalMovieJpegFrameSource.js` — canonical Canvas render -> JPEG Blob at exact time.
- `apps/animator/src/studio/export/browser/CanonicalAudioWav.js` — audio shim -> PCM16 WAV Blob.
- `apps/animator/src/studio/export/browser/CanonicalFfmpegClient.js` — create/upload/finalize/status HTTP contract.
- `apps/animator/src/studio/export/browser/CanonicalMovieFfmpegExport.js` — canonical validate/project/audio/render/upload/finalize orchestration.
- Proof page installer receives `backend=ffmpeg` query and invokes ffmpeg export while preserving existing WebCodecs path for smoke-tested capable environments.

## Verification sequence
1. Source first, all files <=120.
2. Add unit tests for WAV bytes, ffmpeg client request shape, session path validation, and runner plan.
3. Run focused suite + Python compile.
4. Start no-cache proof server and ffmpeg service.
5. Render 30-second / 360-frame proof through canonical browser renderer to JPEG uploads.
6. ffmpeg MP4 + existing browser soundtrack WAV.
7. ffprobe 30-second result.
8. Render full 180-second / 2,160-frame film.
9. ffprobe full result and extract seven encoded-frame witnesses.
10. Only then continue mobile UI, broader tests, legacy split, reread, evidence/delta/handoff closure.
